title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Revelation 22: the river and the tree of life, the angel's words to John, and the last promises and warnings of the book.

questions.text: What proceeded out of the throne of God and of the Lamb?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:1 says he showed John a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

answers.text: A river of water of life, clear as crystal
A sea of glass mixed with fire
Flashes of lightning and thunder
A cloud of incense

questions.text: What were the leaves of the tree of life for?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:2 says the tree of life bore twelve kinds of fruits, and its leaves were for the healing of the nations.

answers.text: For the clothing of the saints
For the light of the city
For the healing of the nations
For the food of the servants

questions.text: What does the text say will be no more, where the throne of God and of the Lamb will be?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:3 says there will be no curse any more, the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

answers.text: The sea
The curse
The nations
The gates

questions.text: Where will his name be, according to the text?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:4 says they will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

answers.text: On the gates of the city
On the foundations of the wall
On a white stone
On their foreheads

questions.text: Why do they need no lamp light or sun light?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:5 says there will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light, for the Lord God will illuminate them.

answers.text: Because the moon shines there always
Because the Lord God will illuminate them
Because the river shines like crystal
Because the angels carry torches

questions.text: Who says that he is the one who heard and saw these things?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:8 says, "Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things."

answers.text: John
David
One of the prophets
One of the elders

questions.text: What did the angel tell him to do when he fell down to worship before his feet?
questions.explanation: The angel said he was a fellow bondservant with John and with his brothers, and told him, "Worship God."

answers.text: To write down the vision
To stand up and measure the city
To worship God
To go back to the assemblies

questions.text: What does the one who comes quickly say he brings with him?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:12 says, "Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work."

answers.text: A sharp sickle for the harvest of the earth
The keys of Death and of Hades
Seven golden bowls full of wrath
His reward, to repay each man's work

questions.text: How does Jesus describe himself in relation to David?
questions.explanation: In Revelation 22:16 Jesus says he is the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.

answers.text: As the root and the offspring of David
As the shepherd of the house of David
As the faithful servant of David
As the city of David restored

questions.text: According to the testimony at the end, what will happen to anyone who adds to the words of this prophecy?
questions.explanation: Revelation 22:18 says that if anyone adds to the words of the prophecy of this book, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

answers.text: He will be shut outside the gates
He will be cast into the lake of fire
God will add to him the plagues written in this book
His name will be blotted from the book of life
